main_text.p: אתמלוכא Ch. Idem. Plur. cum Aff. אתמליכיהון Consi-lia ipsorum, Jerem.18.23.
מלל Pahel Chald. & Syr. Verba facere, Loqui, E-loqui, Effari. Ithpahel אתמלל Loqui: Dici; Syr. [Syriac word] Gemitus qui non dicuntur, id est, inenarrabiles, ad Rom. 8.26.
[Syriac word] Syr. Verbale, Rationale, ad Rom.12.1. Vide notas Tremell. & Jun.
מלתה, מלתא, מלה, מלא Ch. & Syr. Verbum, Sermo. Plural. מלין, מליא, Syr. [Syriac word], [Syriac word].
מלול Ch. Idem. Exo.4.10.emph. מלולא, Jesa.6.4.
מלל Ch. Idem. Esth.7.10. in Targ. sec.
ממללא, ממלל Ch. & Syr. Verbum, sermo, oratio, loquutio, loquela, eloquium: [Syriac word] Loquacitas multa, id est, Multiloquium, Matth.6.7.
[Syriac word] Loquutio turpis, Turpiloquium, ad Coloss.3.8.
מלילין Ch. Spicae. Heb. מלילורת Deut.23.25.
מלפ מלפוניא, Ch. Melones, Melopepones, Gr. est μηλοπέπονες. Num.11.5. in Jon. T. Hier. habet contracte מלפניא.
מלק Ch. Ungue secare, rumpere vel discerpere, ut Hebraice, Levit.1.15. & 5.8.
מלת מילא, מילתא, מילת Ch. Melote, Lana agnina, Lana purissima, mollissima: Al. Sericum exponunt, Sic

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac, Chaldee and Greek words are rendered as far as legible; the vocalised Syriac and pointed Hebrew forms in the scan are only approximated, and some Syriac words are marked by description rather than transcribed. The catchword "Sic" is at the foot right.
